guidance.claim: APSEZ positions itself to consistently deliver 18% to 19% CAGR over coming years.
guidance.quote: Our scale and integrated Port, Logistics, Marine network with 95% of India hinterland coverage, driven by technology-led operations, lean organization and balance sheet capacity to fund the growth positions us to consistently to deliver 18% to 19% CAGR over coming years.
guidance.speaker: Ashwani Gupta

guidance.claim: Steady-state margins for Marine tend to be around 55%.
guidance.quote: But steady-state margins for us in Marine, given the operations that we have had in India and Middle East and Africa, tend to be around that 55% type of a number.
guidance.speaker: Rahul Agarwal

guidance.claim: Expanding domestic port capacity to 1 billion metric tons under Ambition 2031.
guidance.quote: And as outlined in our Ambition 2031, we are rapidly expanding our domestic port capacity to 1 billion metric tons with major projects underway across ports, including Mundra, Dhamra, Vizhinjam, Ennore, Kattupalli.
guidance.speaker: Ashwani Gupta

reported.claim: Q1 FY27 revenue and EBITDA both grew 19% year-on-year.
reported.quote: Quarter 1 FY27, revenue and EBITDA both grew 19% year-on-year to INR 10,821 crores and INR6,541 crores, respectively.
reported.speaker: Ashwani Gupta

reported.claim: Domestic ports delivered 12% revenue and 11% EBITDA jump with 74% margin.
reported.quote: The domestic ports business remained a strong growth engine, delivering 12% revenue, 11% EBITDA jump, while maintaining an industry- leading EBITDA margin of 74%.
reported.speaker: Ashwani Gupta

reported.claim: International ports delivered record revenue of INR 1,747 crores, up 80%.
reported.quote: But this quarter, they delivered record revenue of INR 1,747 crores, up 80% year-on- year, while EBITDA surged 256%.
reported.speaker: Ashwani Gupta

reported.quote: Despite sustaining a high-growth trajectory, net debt-to-EBITDA remains healthy at 1.9x.
reported.speaker: Ashwani Gupta

reported.claim: Marine revenue increased 67% to INR 901 crores.
reported.quote: The Marine revenue increased 67% to INR 901 crores driven by diverse global fleet of 135 vessels.
reported.speaker: Ashwani Gupta
